title: Conversational Incident Creation
story: As a requestor, I want the assistant to create incidents from my conversation, so that I can avoid manually completing ticket forms.

acceptanceCriteria.given: the assistant has gathered required information from the conversation
acceptanceCriteria.when: it is ready to create an incident
acceptanceCriteria.then: it presents a summary for my review before creation

acceptanceCriteria.given: I confirm the incident summary is correct
mandatory details are missing from the conversation
acceptanceCriteria.when: the assistant prepares to create an incident
acceptanceCriteria.then: it requests the missing mandatory details before submission

acceptanceCriteria.given: the assistant presents a summary for confirmation
I confirm and the incident is created successfully
acceptanceCriteria.then: the incident number and record link are displayed

edgeCases: User provides conflicting information across conversation turns
Session timeout during incident creation flow
Very long description exceeding field character limits
